stages.name: verify-command
details: dafny│ make: Nothing to be done for `all'.

boot_sector_512.statement: The built boot sector binary is exactly 512 bytes and its last two bytes are 0x55 0xAA.

enters_protected_mode.statement: The boot sector sets CR0.PE, loads a GDT and far-jumps to the kernel; the disk image holds the kernel after sector 1.

vga_text_output.statement: The kernel sources write character and attribute cells to 0xB8000 and implement clear, print, newline and scroll.

no_external_libs.statement: Sources include no standard or third-party headers other than freestanding ones, and the build uses -ffreestanding and -nostdlib.

boots_in_qemu.statement: Booting the image headless in qemu-system-i386 leaves the kernel banner in VGA memory at 0xB8000.
